summary: Blockchain Digital Infrastructure, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose a 15-year Electric Service Agreement between its subsidiary and a utility provider for up to 65,000 kVA of power at its CLT01 data center. Key terms include a $400,000 monthly minimum demand charge with a deferral mechanism, a $250,000 prepaid early termination fee, and a security deposit of two months' estimated billing. This is a routine operational agreement, not a special situation. No board recommendation is noted. The filing replaces an expiring contract to ensure continuous electric supply.
